policy: MERGE AUTHORIZED requires all required GitHub PR evidence and may be executed only by the Maker.

required.ciConclusion: success for the queried current PR HEAD
required.checkerReview: APPROVED review by Checker bound to headRefOid

deniedWhen: merge conflict or non-clean merge state
a later Checker request-changes or blocked verdict
no Checker APPROVED review bound to current headRefOid
approval comment predates its native HEAD review
Maker attempts to merge without MERGE_AUTHORIZED
sourceOfTruth: GitHub pull request and its comments; local state only mirrors verified GitHub facts.
